context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 complete. Device form redesigned: Wartung and GPS sections removed, 'Erworben am' and 'Portal-Verknüpfung' added under 'Weitere Daten' section, 'Dokumente' renamed to 'Dateiablage'. Serviceplan page has 4 clickable filter cards (Einsatzbereit/Bald fällig/Überfällig/Gesamt) that toggle filtering when clicked. Monitoring now includes stromerzeuger/lichtmast devices as generators with from_device=true and id='dev-{device_id}'. Devices with ausser_betrieb status are correctly excluded from monitoring. SMTP email uses SSL port 465.

mocked_apis.description: Generator telemetry data is simulated (demo data). SMTP email not working due to mail.de auth issue - not a code problem.
